text: Read carefully the poem on page 3. The poet gives her response to being required to keep her
distance from others during the global pandemic.
How does the poet present a strikingly unusual response to the pandemic?
To help you answer this question, you might consider:
• how the poet presents the isolation of her life before the pandemic
• her thoughts and feelings when she steps outside
• the reaction of the man in the street.
Two Metres
Mostly I was silent.

Read carefully the following extract from a novel in which the narrator describes his memories of
Big Kit, who raised him when he was a child. He grew up as a slave on a sugarcane plantation
called Faith.
How does the narrator convey the powerful impression Big Kit made on him?
To help you answer this question, you might consider:
• how he presents his first encounter with Big Kit
• the effect stories about her had on him
• the ways in which her stories opened out his imagination.
All my childhood I’d had no one; only Big Kit, as she was known in the cane.
